latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Canva skill for MCP.

- Provides 22 tools to interact with Canva, including uploading assets, design search, page/content retrieval, folder and brand kit management, and comment/thread handling.
- OAuth authentication is supported and explained for ease of recurring usage.
- Detailed usage, dependency installation, and code examples included.
- Explicit tool guidance and critical requirements are documented, especially for design searching vs. template searching.
